messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "raised prolactin"
set: ["raised prolactin", "raised blood sugar", "raised uric acid", "raised liver enzymes", "raised triglyceride levels", "maintenance dose raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "maintenance dose raised in 10 mg increments at weekly intervals", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "daily dose may be raised in 2.5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "daily dose may be raised in 5 to 10 mg increments at weekly intervals", "dose can be raised in steps of 25 mg to 50 mg a day", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "daily dose may be raised in 10 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "increase by 2.5 mg to 5 mg per day at 1 to 2 week intervals", "raise blood sugar and your doses may need to go up", "milk production from the breasts"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
